name: VerseAir
shortDescription: New UK-developed presentation software for Bible projection, speech-detected references, worship lyrics, service schedules and optional streaming.
suitableContexts: Worship and AV teams that need presentation and service scheduling
Teams that want a free desktop evaluation route for macOS and Windows

pricing.summary: VerseAir publishes a free plan, Pro at $14.99/month and Enterprise at $29.99/month. Every plan starts with a 14-day Pro trial; confirm UK tax, payment currency and annual purchase terms at checkout.

tiers.label: Free
tiers.detail: Manual verse search, one projector screen, limited speech-to-verse use and a limited song library.

tiers.label: Pro
tiers.detail: Adds unlimited speech-to-verse, up to three screens, service schedules, companion app, remote control and media library.

tiers.label: Enterprise
tiers.detail: Adds RTMP streaming, NDI and SDI output, unlimited screens, camera input and priority support.

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier says the downloaded app starts with a 14-day Pro trial without sign-up, card or email; it then continues on the Free plan unless upgraded.

gdprInformation: The supplier links privacy and terms pages. Before using speech recognition, AI tools, companion-app notes or cloud-connected services with real people, request the current data-processing terms, hosting region, sub-processors, retention, deletion and international-transfer details.
coreFeatures: Companion web app and remote control
AI sermon tools on paid plans
RTMP streaming and NDI/SDI output on Enterprise
integrations: RTMP to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch
NDI, OBS, ATEM, vMix and TriCaster support described by supplier
support: Supplier publishes video tutorials and setup guides

uk-operator.value: Companies House records HANDBY LTD, company number 17092920, as an active UK software-development company. VerseAir identifies Handby LTD as its operator.

pricing.value: Supplier publishes a free plan, $14.99/month Pro and $29.99/month Enterprise, with a 14-day Pro trial.

platform-support.value: Supplier publishes downloads for macOS and Windows, with a companion web app for phones.

editorial.assessment: VerseAir is a newly incorporated UK supplier with an unusually broad and technically ambitious presentation offer: speech-assisted verse projection, worship sets, service schedules, companion viewing and optional broadcast outputs. It is worth a controlled AV-team evaluation, but its newness means churches should validate performance, licensing, accessibility, security and support against their actual service before depending on it live.
bestFor: Churches interested in speech-assisted Bible projection
AV teams that need macOS and Windows presentation options
Teams willing to run a low-risk evaluation before moving live services
strengths: Free desktop plan and no-card 14-day Pro evaluation
Presentation, worship planning, companion and streaming capabilities are clearly separated by plan
Supports macOS and Windows according to the supplier
limitations: The supplier is newly incorporated and has no long public operating record
Published paid prices are in USD rather than GBP
Churches must independently confirm copyright and public-performance permissions for each Bible translation, lyric and media item
AI, speech, companion and streaming features require current privacy, security, hosting and reliability review before live use

procurementVerdict.problem: Reducing manual work in Bible projection while retaining a full worship-presentation workflow
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Speech-to-verse projection combined with a free desktop plan and optional companion and broadcast features
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a rehearsal using the church's projector, microphones, worship content, accessibility needs and internet connection, then obtain the applicable licences and support-contact details
